/* DROP SCRIPT

DROP SECURITY POLICY [RLS_DW].[POL_DW]
DROP FUNCTION RLS_DW.AccessPredicate
DROP SCHEMA RLS_DW

*/




CREATE SCHEMA RLS_DW
GO

-- Creation of security function.
-- Function to define what will be use as filter on tables
CREATE FUNCTION RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(@BankSK int, @SourceSystemCode varchar(20))
    RETURNS TABLE
WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
    RETURN SELECT 1 AS AccessPredicateResult 
	FROM DW.RefRowLevelSecurityFilter ref_rls
	WHERE ref_rls.UserEmail = USER_NAME() AND
	(	
		@BankSK = BankSK AND @SourceSystemCode = SourceSystemCode
		
	)


-- Assigning of security filter per table
CREATE SECURITY POLICY [RLS_DW].[POL_DW]
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[DimAccount],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[DimAccountHolderType],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[DimAccountProduct],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[DimAccountProductRLS],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[DimAccountRLS],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[DimCustomer],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[DimCustomerAccount],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[DimCustomerRiskRating],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[DimInstitutionalBankingGroupList],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[DimProduct],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[DimRiskRating],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[DimRiskRatingType],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[DimUserAccess],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[DimWealthManagementGroupList],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[FactAggTotalCustomerHoldings],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[FactAverageDailyBalanceMTD],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[FactCardsCreditLimit],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[FactCardsOutstandingBalance],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[FactCardsRelationshipExposure],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[FactDepositsOutstandingBalance],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[FactLoansBilledAmount],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[FactLoansCreditLimit],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[FactLoansOutstandingBalance],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[FactLoansRelationshipExposure],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[FactSecurityPortfolio],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[FactTotalRelationshipBalance],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[FactTotalRelationshipExposure],
ADD FILTER PREDICATE RLS_DW.AccessPredicate(BankSK,SourceSystemCode) ON [DW].[FactTreasuryOutstandingInvestment],

WITH (STATE = ON);
